data.exact_reserve_text: The improved performance is credited to the claims ratio improving significantly. This resulted from releases in reserves from 2017, 2015 and prior years, where claims from these years have developed favourably in the year as the impact of the remediation and improvements are starting to emerge.

prior_year_events.event_name: Ogden discount rate change / PIDR review
prior_year_events.impact_description: Change in the Ogden discount rate and associated reviews affected personal injury reserves; management set claims provisions on a 0% Ogden basis and noted that a move to between 0.5% and 1.0% would reduce reserves on 2018 and prior years by several million pounds.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 218 recorded a net release in prior-year claims reserves at year-end 2018. Using the gross claims development triangle, older underwriting years (2011-2016) show a cumulative favourable development of approximately GBP 90.7m, driven by favourable claims development and remediation/improvement actions in underwriting and claims handling. Management also notes sensitivity to the Ogden discount rate which could further reduce reserves if changed upwards.
raw_causal_phrases: releases in reserves from 2017, 2015 and prior years
claims from these years have developed favourably
the impact of the remediation and improvements are starting to emerge

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (note 5(e)) because the explicit 'Movement in prior accident year's provision for claims outstanding' note provided only 'Net claims' figures. The triangle values are presented in GBP 000 and have been converted to millions for summary fields. There are two differing narrative ranges quoted for Ogden sensitivity in the report (one stating a GBP 4.2m-GBP 8.5m potential reduction and another stating GBP 3.0m-GBP 6.0m); this inconsistency is noted. RITC / reinsurance commutation activity is present in the report and may distort development for some years, but the triangle was used after review.
